args.title: Fix CSV export to handle multiple currencies
args.body: Issue 4206 reports a bug in the CSV export functionality in src/export/csv.ts. The current implementation merges rows that have the same date, amount, and description but different currencies, which leads to data loss in the exported CSV file. This change will adjust the logic to ensure that each transaction is represented correctly in the output, preserving all currency values in the export. This issue became noticeable after the release of version 3.2.0, when transactions started carrying currency information.
